_version: Admin settings for CurWork Beta 0.011 - DRAFT - For Internal Use (FPT) - updated 2026-11-22 13:42 UTC - modified by: mbitar
_help: PROTECTED admin settings. Keys that start with _ are notes and are ignored. Put this file next to CurWork.exe. Each user's own preferences go in curwork_user_settings.json, which can never change these settings.
_browse_roots_help: S3 folders billers can download from. Must not overlap output_stages.
_output_stages_help: Result types shown in the drop-down and the S3 folder each one uploads to.
_aws_cli_path_help: Optional full path to aws.exe. Empty = look in Program Files, then PATH (never the current folder).
_login_banner_help: Optional system-use notice (NIST 800-53 AC-8) shown at start-up. Billers must click OK to continue.
_settings_parameter_help: Optional AWS Parameter Store name, such as /curwork/admin-settings. When set, the bucket, folders, KMS key and upload rules come only from that parameter, which only the AWS admin role can change (use curwork_admin.py). Empty = everything comes from this file.
_user_settings_location_help: Where each user's preferences file goes: tool_folder (next to CurWork.exe; if users can't write there, it falls back to the work folder) or work_folder.
_sso_help: Optional. If filled in, CurWork adds the AWS profile to the laptop the first time a biller clicks Sign in.
